ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Dominantly low-intensity (black) pixel distribution with sparse, localized high-intensity (white) features; estimated white-to-black pixel ratio of 1:12.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-contrast white features mapped as discrete circular rings (rosettes) and groups of parallel linear streaks. Rings are distributed centrally on both lobes; linear streaks are concentrated in the mid-to-distal sections of the left and right lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Visible V-shaped central indentation with an estimated pixel-calculated angle of 105 degrees and a shallow depth relative to the lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular trailing edge boundary exhibiting high-frequency serrations with pixel-amplitudes varying between 4 and 15 pixels, particularly pronounced on the distal margins.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Continuous convex curvature originating from the median notch and sweeping upward and outward toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple groups of unaligned, high-contrast linear white pixel disruptions (rake marks) oriented horizontally and diagonally on both lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Presence of multiple circular barnacle scars and parallel linear rake marks; visible white calcified growth or barnacle colonization at the extreme distal tips of both lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: Distinctive high-intensity white cluster at the far outer corners (tips) of both lobes, contrasting sharply with the adjacent dark pigment and water background.
